caption:
You keep patching over the shame. But the covering you sewed with your own hands was never going to hold. (Galatians 6:15 devotional)

You keep stitching religious effort over the shame, hoping this time the covering finally holds — but fig leaves sewn by your own hands never could. In Eden God clothed the shame Himself, at the cost of the first death, and at the cross He weaves the only garment that covers you: His own righteousness, and calls you a new creation. You're not left patching yourself; you're clothed, made new, and sent out carrying the peace that came from His cross.

📌 Save this when you're patching your own shame
📩 Send it to someone exhausted from hiding it
